decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper sits close to the established dumper range, so holding it costs little through shared engineering, parts and service, and two years reveal too little to abandon it.
The articulated dumper extends the core construction offer cheaply, and with no negative signals and demand still unresolved, the option is worth keeping open.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant and niche with long sales cycles, but it draws on underground expertise and complements the new mining loader, so it is too early to abandon it despite higher uncertainty.

The material lift line is close to the core and shows strong positive evidence, being the most popular lift in rental and winning a large order, which justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.

Although distant from the core, the compact mining loader has early quantified field results of 1,000 operating hours in seven months, which reduce uncertainty favorably and support keeping and developing the option.
